result.edit: The failure shows the output was 0 when expected to be 1 at count=1 cycle=2 mode=0. In mode=0 (even period), the condition for setting clk_out_r was using div_e>>2 (div_e/4) instead of div_e>>1 (div_e/2) as specified. Changing to div_e>>1 matches the public waveform contract where output should be 1 iff count <= floor(div_e/2) + 1 in even mode.
